name: Amy Ritchey
notable_stories: Died on Mother's Day at 99.5 years old
Elaine, Les Rinehart and son Jerry lived with Elmer and Amy during hard times; Amy chose bathing Jerry over cooking dinner, and she and Elaine stayed close until Amy's death.
milestones: Married Elmer Spencer Kulp (m. 4 Jun 1931, Bellingham, Whatcom Co, Washington)
career: Amy was an elementary school teacher in Whatcom County whose students included Elaine, Beryl, Orval and Howard Simons.
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Marriage date confirmed: 4 June 1931, Bellingham. Fixes prior issue where Elmer Spencer Kulp's spouse field incorrectly pointed to himself.
